metadata.description: How Passvero processes personal data for access requests, use of the application and viewing public digital product passports.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains personal data processing on Passvero’s public pages and business application, including access requests and public digital product passports (DPPs).

scope.title: Who we are and our roles
scope.body:
Passvero is operated by Živić-elektro j.d.o.o., 204. vukovarske brigade 39, 32000 Vukovar, Croatia, OIB 90344764519. The privacy contact is contact@passvero.eu. This is the controller’s contact, not a designation of an appointed data protection officer.

We act as controller for our own business relationship, accounts, support and service protection. When an organisation determines the purpose and content of personal data in products, contacts, images or documents, it will generally be the controller and we process data on its behalf. Roles, lawful instructions and responsibilities are governed by an appropriate processing agreement. An organisation acting as a processor must be authorised to engage further processing.

data.title: Data we process
data.body:
An access request contains a contact name, email, organisation name and language. We retain the decision and related notification records. Accounts involve identity, email verification, password hashes, activation and verification data, sessions, memberships and permissions. Passwords are not stored in readable form.

For offers and billing we process business names, addresses, country, supplied tax and VAT identifiers, billing email, offers, acceptances, periods and payment references. We do not process payment card numbers.

We process entered products, translations, manufacturer details, images, PDFs and versions, which may contain personal data. Data comes from you or authorised people in your organisation. Correspondence includes messages and attachments you send. Use of the service creates audit, security and delivery records and technical request/session data, such as time, IP address and browser information, depending on the infrastructure involved.

use.title: Purposes and legal bases
use.body:
We use data to handle access, accounts and permissions, provide the service, manage and publish content, handle offers and billing, support users, protect security, maintain business traceability and recover data.

Where you personally are the contracting party, processing necessary to prepare and perform the contract is based on that contract. For business communication with organisation representatives and service protection, we rely on the legitimate interest in managing and protecting the business relationship, taking account of your rights. Legal obligations apply to records subject to them. For client content, we follow lawful instructions from the relevant controller. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it.

Required fields are needed for the requested process or function; without them, approval, login or service provision may not be possible. Activation, verification, password reset and other transactional messages are not a newsletter. Security checks may temporarily limit attempts or require an additional check; access is approved by an authorised person. We do not use data for advertising profiling.

sharing.title: Publication, recipients and providers
sharing.body:
Account, billing and internal records are not public DPP content. Private access depends on permissions. Uploading a file does not publish it. Authorised publication makes selected published-version data and permitted images/PDFs publicly available, including through a QR code. Others may download content; withdrawal on Passvero does not remove their earlier copies.

We use Hostinger for hosting and email, Supabase for files, Backblaze B2 for backups and Cloudflare Turnstile for additional protection when requested. Banks and accounting services process relevant business data. Telegram carries technical operator alerts, not customer documents. Data may also be disclosed where required by law. We do not sell personal data.

Confirmed primary storage is in Germany for the VPS and Hostinger email, Ireland for Supabase and the Netherlands for B2; accounting software is used locally in Croatia. This does not mean all support access and processing are limited to the EEA. You may request details of recipients and applicable international transfers at contact@passvero.eu.

Supabase is used here for Storage files, not the application database or authentication. The public contracts of Hostinger, Supabase and Backblaze provide standard contractual clauses for relevant transfers outside the EEA; a storage location alone does not establish that no transfers occur. Information about specific recipients, applicable safeguards and how to obtain a copy is available at contact@passvero.eu. Telegram has a separate controller role for its own service; we do not describe it as a contracted processor for client content.

We use MER, Elektronički računi d.o.o., to deliver e-invoices to customers in Croatia, sharing the invoice and recipient data needed for that service. Customers outside Croatia receive a PDF invoice at the email address in their billing details, through the existing Hostinger email service.

retention.title: Retention and backups
retention.body:
The private product-data retention policy provides for 12 months after a paid package expires and 3 months after a trial ends. Public DPP availability follows separate subscription and regulatory rules. The periods below are a schedule for review, minimisation and removal of unnecessary personal data, not a promise of automatic deletion.

Undecided access requests are reviewed 90 days after receipt. Unnecessary rejected-request data are scheduled for removal 6 calendar months after the decision; redundant approved-request data 6 months after completed activation. Unactivated requests are reviewed within 30 days after activation expiry. Necessary evidence of the decision is handled separately.

Accounts and memberships are retained during the active relationship and authorised access. After closure is completed, the target is to remove unnecessary profile and credential data within 30 days. Other active memberships and necessary business records are assessed separately. For unnecessary session and token data, the target is 30 days after expiry, revocation or consumption, measured from the later applicable closing event. The current billing profile is minimised within 30 days after the business relationship has fully ended if no longer needed.

Operational audit records have a review and minimisation period of 12 calendar months from the event; delivery records 90 days from the final outcome after the last attempt; technical logs 30 days from entry; abuse-prevention records 30 days from the last attempt. Technical Telegram alerts to the operator have a 90-day target from the message. An unresolved delivery outcome does not trigger automatic resending.

Accounting documents covered by the Croatian Accounting Act are retained for at least 11 years from the relevant financial year-end. Fiscalised e-invoices have a special 6-year period from the issue year-end. Classification matters: not every PDF invoice qualifies. Offers, acceptances, payment references and correspondence are classified by evidential purpose, accounting duties and applicable claim periods, with no single period for all messages.

Unaccepted or expired offers with no other retention basis have a 6-calendar-month period from expiry or explicit rejection. Routine support and correspondence have a 12-calendar-month period from case closure; necessary financial and contractual evidence is separated into the appropriate category.

Separately retained necessary evidence of a security incident is kept for up to 6 calendar months from resolution. Minimal evidence of the response to a personal-data rights request has a 3-year period from case closure: the necessary scope of the request, decision, dates and proof of sending, without the full data export or a routine copy of an identity document. These are business-policy periods, not general statutory minimums; the end of the purpose or exercise of rights may require earlier removal.

A specific dispute, incident or legal duty may justify separate, longer retention of necessary evidence. Its reason, scope and continuing need are reviewed, normally every 30 days. Backups follow a separate schedule: deletion from the active system does not immediately erase every older copy. For category-specific information or requests, contact contact@passvero.eu.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability and object, particularly to processing based on legitimate interests. Where consent is the basis, you may withdraw it without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Email contact@passvero.eu with enough information to locate the relevant account or processing; do not send your password. Identity checks are proportionate to the request. We respond without undue delay, normally within one month. Where legal conditions are met, this can be extended by two further months, with notice and reasons within the first month. For client content, we involve the relevant controller.

Others’ rights and legal obligations may limit a request. You may complain to AZOP (azop.hr) or another competent supervisory authority. CSV is not a complete export of every version and file; the scope of a personal data request is assessed separately.

security.title: Security and Turnstile
security.body:
We apply access controls, organisation permissions, password hashing, protected sessions and file checks. These measures reduce risk but cannot guarantee an absence of incidents.

When Turnstile is activated, Cloudflare processes signals such as IP address, browser and connection information to prevent automated abuse. Under its policy, it acts as processor to provide protection and as a separate controller to improve detection. Details are in the Cloudflare Turnstile Privacy Addendum. Our Cookie Policy explains session technologies. For security and privacy enquiries, contact contact@passvero.eu.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: This policy describes login cookies, language selection and additional security checks on Passvero’s public pages and application.

overview.title: Purpose and scope
overview.body: We use session technologies needed for the login you request and service protection. Consent requirements and necessity depend on the actual purpose of the technology. This policy does not grant general permission for future analytics or tracking.

necessary.title: Login and security cookies
necessary.body:
__Secure-better-auth.session_token links the browser to the authenticated session; __Secure-better-auth.dont_remember indicates login without persistent remembering. They use Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax and have no persistent browser Max-Age in the existing flow. The server session for this flow lasts 24 hours; this is not account retention.

When additional protection is required, Cloudflare Turnstile loads and processes technical browser/connection signals. It is not our analytics or advertising tool. Additional storage depends on widget configuration; we do not claim that every mode is cookie-free. Further information is in the Cloudflare Turnstile Privacy Addendum.

locale.title: Language and installation
locale.body: Language is determined by the URL, automatic detection is disabled and we do not set NEXT_LOCALE. Browser installation uses a manifest and icons; it does not introduce additional analytics cookies, push notifications or a separate offline mode.

analytics.title: Analytics and advertising
analytics.body: We currently have no integrated advertising or marketing analytics tools or first-party analytics cookies. We do not show a selection panel for optional cookies that are not used. This does not mean external security checks do not process technical data.

control.title: Browser controls
control.body: You can sign out and inspect, block or remove cookies in your browser. Restoring an earlier browser session may preserve session cookies; use sign-out to end login. Blocking necessary session or security mechanisms may prevent login or the requested check.

changes.title: Changes and contact
changes.body: If we introduce technologies that require consent, an appropriate choice must precede their use. Contact contact@passvero.eu with questions. Other processing is described in the Privacy Policy.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These terms describe Passvero’s business service, access, content responsibilities and existing subscription contracting process. An individually accepted offer governs the specific agreed scope.

introduction.title: 1. Provider and scope
introduction.body: Passvero is provided by Živić-elektro j.d.o.o., 204. vukovarske brigade 39, 32000 Vukovar, Croatia, OIB 90344764519; Croatian court register number (MBS) 030125449, Commercial Court in Osijek (Trgovački sud u Osijeku). contact@passvero.eu. The service is intended for business users. Visiting the site or requesting access does not itself accept a paid offer.

service.title: 2. Service
service.body: Passvero supports preparing, managing and publishing product data, translations, manufacturer details, images and PDFs, versioning DPP content and generating/downloading QR codes. Drafts and draft changes are not public until published. A QR code is a link, not confirmation of accuracy or official regulatory status.

eligibility.title: 3. Access and accounts
eligibility.body: Requests are followed by approval, activation and email verification. You must be authorised to act for your organisation and protect credentials. Organisation and platform permissions are assigned separately. Report suspected unauthorised access to contact@passvero.eu.

acceptableUse.title: 4. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body:
Unlawful or malicious content, infringement of others’ rights, unauthorised access and disruption are prohibited. Do not enter unnecessary personal data or content you are not authorised to process. Do not bypass permissions, quotas or security checks.

Report suspected illegal content to contact@passvero.eu with the exact link or identifier, reasons and a reply contact. Do not send unnecessary personal data. Restrictions should be proportionate; an affected user may request reasons and human review at the same contact, subject to legal restrictions and protection of the procedure.

productData.title: 5. Content and publication
productData.body: The organisation is responsible for content accuracy, completeness, legality, rights and publication decisions, including personal data in documents and contacts. Published versions are separate from draft changes. Uploading is not publication; public delivery requires appropriate settings and security checks. Others may keep earlier public copies.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Content and software rights
intellectualProperty.body: You retain rights to your content and allow processing, storage and display only as needed for the service and lawful instructions. You do not acquire ownership of Passvero software, design or branding. Personal-data roles and processing are additionally governed by the applicable processing agreement.

thirdPartyServices.title: 7. Infrastructure and communication
thirdPartyServices.body: The service uses external hosting, file, email, backup and security providers. Their outages can affect availability. Activation, verification, security and business messages form part of the relevant process, not a marketing newsletter. Processing details are described in the Privacy Policy.

availability.title: 8. Trial and subscription
availability.body:
One trial per organisation runs for six calendar months from successful activation: three products created in total, 100 MiB storage and five PDF attachments per version. Archiving does not restore a trial slot.

Paid access follows a request, offer, acceptance, bank transfer and separate activation confirmation. Standard periods are 3 or 12 calendar months; offers are valid for 30 calendar days from issue. Prices are in EUR excluding VAT for the whole stated period. Tax treatment, total amount and quotas are set by the individual offer. Invoices are issued separately; there is no automatic charging or renewal. Later price lists do not change an accepted offer.

Customers in Croatia receive an e-invoice through MER, Elektronički računi d.o.o. Customers outside Croatia receive a PDF invoice by email at the address provided in their billing details.

disclaimer.title: 9. Service limitations
disclaimer.body: Passvero is not legal advice, official certification or a guarantee of regulatory compliance. Users verify requirements for their products. PDF checks do not guarantee safety, authenticity or legal validity; displaying a QR code or GTIN does not confirm GS1 registration.

liability.title: 10. Availability and liability
liability.body:
Maintenance, security interventions and failures may interrupt the service. Without a separate agreement, we do not promise a particular SLA or error-free operation. Backups do not replace available user exports. Mandatory legal rights and responsibilities are preserved; liability is assessed under applicable law and the individual contract.

These terms do not exclude or limit in advance liability for intentional misconduct or gross negligence, or other rights or liabilities that applicable law does not permit to be limited. Statutory remedies for non-performance, termination, refunds or damages remain available where their conditions are met.

termination.title: 11. Expiry and termination
termination.body:
Expiry limits product editing and new publication. Permitted private viewing, available exports and billing-data changes depend on permissions. Paid packages provide six further calendar months of public availability for voluntary publications; trials have no additional period. The private product-data retention policy is 12 months after a paid package and 3 after a trial, without promising automatic deletion.

Mandatory or unresolved regulatory cases require separate review and arrangements, without presuming legal obligations end or unlimited free hosting is available. Contact us for closure and available exports. CSV is not a full history/file export. Ending access does not erase all records. Abuse or serious risk may require restrictions, subject to applicable obligations.

References to available exports do not limit mandatory rights of data access, switching providers or portability where applicable. The scope and secure handover method depend on the type of request and applicable rules.

governingLaw.title: 12. Contractual relationship
governingLaw.body: The accepted offer, individually agreed terms and mandatory law apply. These terms do not exclude rights that cannot legally be limited. Disputes and jurisdiction are determined under applicable rules and the relevant contract.

contact.title: 13. Contact
contact.body: For contractual enquiries, renewal, package changes, termination or available exports: contact@passvero.eu. Renewal and package changes require appropriate confirmation. A downgrade does not automatically delete content to meet lower quotas; there is no automatic entitlement to a refund, credit or extension.

changes.title: 14. Changes to terms
changes.body: We publish the date of a new version. Changes to an existing contractual relationship follow the appropriate notice and acceptance process; changing the public page alone does not overwrite an already accepted offer.

CatalogImport.scope: Creates new active products with drafts only. internal_name also becomes the source translation name. Manufacturers, other translations, materials, images, PDFs and history are not imported.

CatalogImport.resumeHelp: After interruption, use the same file, mapping and row selection. Successful rows will not be duplicated. Cancellation stops future work but does not remove created products. Raw CSV is not stored; hashes and outcomes are retained for resumption.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot import. Remaining work has stopped.
errors.FILE: Check CSV, UTF-8 encoding, selected delimiter and file/row limits.
errors.MAPPING: Check mapping. Name is required; a column cannot be mapped more than once.
errors.STALE_PREVIEW: Preview expired or does not match file and mapping. Repeat preview.
errors.SELECTION: Selection contains a conflict or unacknowledged GTIN, or differs from the confirmed import.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Import is unavailable in this user context.
errors.FAILED: Request did not finish. Resume the same import to check stored outcomes.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Choose a plan and period. The offer is issued outside Passvero; an authorized operator activates the subscription after confirming payment.
Subscription.quotaNotice: Content changes and new publication require active rights. Quotas include retained assets and reservations.
Subscription.noCurrent: There is no current paid period.
Subscription.priceNotice: Price for the entire period excluding VAT; not a monthly installment.
Subscription.replaceConfirm: I confirm replacement of the open request. Its offer and acceptance will no longer apply.
Subscription.renewalNotice: Initial purchase and same-plan renewal are available.
Subscription.billingRequired: Complete the company billing profile before requesting a plan.
Subscription.readOnly: Only an OWNER can submit a request or accept an offer.
Subscription.expired: The offer has expired. A new offer and acceptance are required before activation.
Subscription.retention: Voluntary public passports: 6 more months after paid expiry. Private retention: 12 months. Mandatory or unresolved DPP requires a separate agreement. There is no automatic permanent deletion.
Subscription.onPayment: The period starts on explicit payment confirmation. Dates are calculated in Europe/Zagreb.
Subscription.contiguous: Renewal continues from the previous end, preserving remaining days.
Subscription.acceptConfirm: I have reviewed the external offer and accept all displayed terms, amounts, quotas, periods and the billing snapshot.
Subscription.offerNotice: Enter details of an externally issued offer. A new revision requires new OWNER acceptance. Passvero does not issue offers or invoices.
Subscription.simulationNotice: A simulated payment does not verify a real bank transaction.
Subscription.paymentConfirm: I confirm the selected payment type, external reference and activation of the displayed accepted terms.
Subscription.failure: The action was not confirmed. Refresh the state before retrying.
Subscription.conflict: The state changed or the offer is no longer valid. Refresh and review the terms again.
Subscription.forbidden: You are not authorized for this action.
Subscription.historyNotice: Up to 50 most recent requests are shown.
Subscription.replaceAccepted: The OWNER must explicitly replace the accepted request; then a new offer must be recorded and accepted again.
Subscription.reviewRequired: The existing subscription requires billing operator review before a new request.
Subscription.priceMismatch: The net amount must match the current plan price for the entire period. Check the catalog and external offer.
Subscription.contentLock: Content changes and new publication require active rights. Quotas include retained assets and reservations.
Subscription.issued: External offer issue date and time
Subscription.issuedHint: Enter the actual issue time in Europe/Zagreb. The offer is valid for 30 calendar days from issuance, not from recording in Passvero.
Subscription.upgradeConsequence: Upgrade activates after payment, keeping the current period end. Explicit supplement; no automatic proration.
Subscription.downgradeConsequence: Downgrade starts after paid coverage ends. All limits are checked at activation. Over-limit activation stays blocked; old rights expire. No automatic refund, credit or rescheduling. A separate audited replacement agreement is required.
Subscription.blockedDowngrade: Paid downgrade blocked; operator agreement required.
Subscription.replacementConsequence: Separate replacement after blocked downgrade: a new full-price period starts on confirmed payment. Historical receipts remain unchanged. No automatic refund or credit.
Subscription.availableCreationSlots: Remaining creation slots: {count}. Preview does not reserve quota.
